request.style: English, male country solo, acoustic guitar, fiddle, mandolin, warm and reflective, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The land of Seir held the old ways
The Horite chiefs kept the mountain days
Lotan and Shobal stood the test
Zibeon and Anah were the best
Dishon and Ezer lived in the land
Dishan was the last of the band
These were the sons of Seir the Horite
In the place that they called their site

[Chorus]
Hemdan and Eshban stood tall
Ithran and Keran heard the call
Sons of Dishon in the genealogy
Names written in the history
Before the Esauites took the land
They walked across the Seir land

[Verse]
The descendants of Esau came near
They drove the old clans from the sphere
Wiped them out and settled in place
Just like Israel in that location
Thirty-eight years the men did fade
The hand of the Lord was in the shade
To root them out until they perished
As the Lord had sworn and whispered

[Chorus]
Hemdan and Eshban stood tall
Ithran and Keran heard the call
Sons of Dishon in the genealogy
Names written in the history
Before the Esauites took the land
They walked across the Seir land

[Bridge]
Anah had a son named Dishon
His lineage is not forgotten
Cherans and Kerans keep the name
Though the power slowly changed

[Outro]
They lived in Seir to this day
Under the shadow of the sway
